verdict.rationale: Mercury's first-party material covers all three areas of the story on one platform. Banking includes checking, savings and treasury accounts with internal transfers. Spend management includes virtual and credit cards with limits, reimbursements and approvals 'all in one place,' plus receipt auto-matching. Bill pay includes AI bill reading and payouts by ACH, check and wire. A long-time customer independently confirms using many virtual cards with limits and purpose-named accounts with auto-funding. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of bill pay and reimbursements, and evidence that users actually replaced separate spend or AP tools with Mercury.
